description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for a specified document in the knowledge base bound to a Luma Agent. The URL is valid for one hour by default
description_zh: 获取 Luma Agent 绑定的知识库中指定文档的临时下载地址，默认有效期一小时
name: GetLumaDocumentDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaCatalogs to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaNamespaces to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的命名空间名称。可通过 ListLumaNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the knowledge base bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaKnowledgeBases to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的知识库名称。可通过 ListLumaKnowledgeBases 获取
parameters.name: knowledge_base_name

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the document. You can call ListLumaDocuments to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 文档的唯一标识。可通过 ListLumaDocuments 获取
parameters.name: document_id

parameters.help_en:
Valid values:
public: public network.
vpc: internal network.

Default value: public
parameters.help_zh: 取值：public（公网）、vpc（内网）。不传时默认公网
parameters.name: network_type

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call succeeds. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The pre-signed download URL information for the original document
Data.description_zh: 文档原文的预签名下载 URL 信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: The pre-signed download URL for the original document. The URL is valid for a limited period of time
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 文档原文的预签名下载 URL，短时间内有效

ExpireAt.description_en: The expiration time of the download URL in UTC
ExpireAt.description_zh: 下载 URL 的过期时间（UTC）
ExpireAt.title_en: 下载地址过期时间（ISO8601 UTC）
ExpireAt.title_zh: 下载地址过期时间（ISO8601 UTC）

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value is Operation success if the call succeeds, or a specific error description if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Use this ID for troubleshooting or when submitting a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates that the call succeeds
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
